name: Zawiya Oil Refinery
detail: Libya's largest operating refinery, 120,000 bpd capacity; repeatedly struck by drones Aug 2026, NOC weighing force majeure.

name: Mellitah Oil & Gas Complex
detail: Piped 30M m³/day of gas to Italy; stormed by blackout protesters Jul 28, 2026 before GNU forces secured it.

name: Mitiga Air Base
detail: Central Tripoli air base; Turkish military presence supporting GNU forces.

name: Al-Watiya Air Base
detail: Western Libya air base hosting Turkish forces and UAV operations.

name: Al-Jufra Air Base
detail: Central Libya base; hub for Russia's Africa Corps (Wagner successor) personnel and aircraft, 1,000–2,000 estimated personnel.

name: Qardabiya Air Base
detail: Near Sirte; site of repositioned Russian warplanes and Wagner-linked fighters.

name: Khoms Naval Base
detail: Turkish naval base supporting GNU maritime operations.

name: Sirte / Oil Crescent Line
detail: De facto GNU-LNA demarcation line; site of the Apr-Jun 2026 Flintlock exercise and Jul 12 Chiefs of Staff talks.

name: Central Bank of Libya HQ
detail: Controls oil revenue and currency issuance; governor's Aug 2026 resignation reignited east-west control dispute.

name: Es Sider Oil Terminal
detail: Major Oil Crescent export terminal underpinning Libya's 2026 production highs.

name: Benina International Airport
detail: Benghazi's airport; used for migrant repatriation flights and eastern LNA logistics.
